blocks.text: Capacitor aisi device hai jo electrical energy ko electric field ki shakal mein jama (store) karti hai. Yahan aisi do devices parhenge: (i) isolated (akele) spherical conductors aur (ii) parallel plate capacitors.

Jo spherical conductor (dhaat ka gola) doosre conductors aur un ke asar se door khali jagah mein rakha ho, use isolated spherical conductor kehte hain. Is gole ki charge jama karne ki salahiyat ko capacitance kehte hain, aur isay C se likhte hain.

blocks.title: Isolated spherical conductor ki capacitance
blocks.text: Isolated spherical conductor ki capacitance woh charge hai jo gole ki surface ke har aik volt potential par us par jama ho. Yani charge ÷ surface ka potential.

blocks.alt: Radius R ka gola jis ki satah ke bilkul andar har taraf + nishan hain. Markaz par Q, satah ke aik nuqte tak radius R, aur us nuqte par V likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.5: Radius R ka charged akela spherical conductor (kitab ki Figure 16.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki figure mein + charges poore gole ke andar bikhre hue hain. Conductor mein charge hamesha bahar ki satah par rehta hai, andar nahi, is liye khaake mein + nishan satah par hain. Q gole ka kul charge hai aur V us ki satah ka potential.
Yahan Q jama shuda charge aur V woh potential hai jo Q gole ki surface par paida karta hai (Fig. 16.5). Capacitance ki SI unit farad (F) hai.

blocks.title: Farad
blocks.text: Spherical conductor ke liye 1 farad us gole ki capacitance hai jo 1 volt potential par 1 coulomb charge jama kare, jab gola khali jagah mein akela ho.
Radius R wale gole ki surface par potential:
Agar gola kisi medium mein ho jis ka dielectric constant εᵣ hai, to:

Eq. (16.26) batati hai ke gole ki capacitance charge ya potential par munhasir nahi; yeh sirf radius aur medium par munhasir hai. Radius barhe to capacitance barhti hai, yani bara gola usi surface potential par zyada charge rakhta hai. Dielectric medium bhi capacitance barhata hai.

Hawa mein 10 cm radius ke akele dhaat ke gole ki capacitance nikalein. Hal: C = 4πε₀R = 4 × 3.14 × (8.85 × 10⁻¹² F m⁻¹)(0.10 m) = 1.1 × 10⁻¹¹ F = 11 pF. Poori zameen (R = 6.4 × 10⁶ m) ki capacitance bhi sirf taqreeban 7 × 10⁻⁴ F hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke 1 farad bohat bari unit hai.

blocks.prompt: Do akele golon ke radius 5 cm aur 10 cm hain. Kis ki capacitance zyada hai, aur kitne guna?
blocks.explanation: 10 cm wale gole ki, do guna (double), kyunke C = 4πε₀R, yani C radius ke seedha mutabiq hai.

items: Capacitor energy ko electric field mein jama karta hai.
Isolated gola: C = Q/V = 4πε₀R; medium mein C = 4πε₀εᵣR.
1 F = 1 C/1 V; farad bohat bari unit hai.
